# Sprint 2 contract: Exceptions and clean codes

INVENTED TEST FIXTURE: a builder's sprint contract in the opchain project format.

## Deliverables
- A line whose product code matches no item stops on the exceptions list with the code and the customer.
- A one-off clean-up puts every product code in the order sheet and every item in QuickBooks Online into the LC-nnnn form.

## Testable criteria
| # | Criterion | How it is verified |
|---|---|---|
| AC-2.1 | 3 orders with one unknown code each: all 3 lines on the exceptions list | spec/06-testing.md AC-2.1 test data |
| AC-4.1 | 40 sheet rows and 20 items sampled: all in the LC-nnnn form | spec/06-testing.md AC-4.1 test data |
